subtitles.en: Let's get more on this in FIFA's decision with Bloomberg senior reporter Randall Williams, who covers sports in the co-host of the Bloomberg Business Sports Podcast.
subtitles.zh: 我们来听听彭博社高级记者兰德尔·威廉姆斯对国际足联决定的解读，他负责体育报道，也是彭博商业体育播客的联合主持人。

subtitles.en: Trump making the argument there, I guess, against red cards in general saying it's so unfair to punish someone for a game that hasn't happened. But this is without precedent. I know we're talking
subtitles.zh: 特朗普在那边辩称，红牌制度不公平，因为惩罚尚未发生的比赛。但这史无前例。我们知道在休息时讨论过，

subtitles.en: about this in the break. It's happened going into the qualifying. But revoking or suspending a red card during knockouts? It's unprecedented. It's absolutely unprecedented. As we spoke about before,
subtitles.zh: 资格赛阶段有过先例，但在淘汰赛阶段撤销或暂停红牌？这绝对史无前例。正如我们之前所说，
en_highlights: revoking or suspending a red card

subtitles.en: this happened with Cristiano Ronaldo months ago. FIFA pushed some matches that he was supposed to be suspended for way off down the line. And the issue with that is that this is going
subtitles.zh: 几个月前C罗也遇到过类似情况。国际足联将他本应禁赛的比赛推迟到很晚。问题在于，

subtitles.en: to be even all those last tournament. Now, as it pertains to, uh, uh, uh, uh, uh, flow balligan is that flow, this is a round of 16 match. And he has the potential to impact this
subtitles.zh: 这会影响整个赛事。现在，就普利西奇而言，这是16强赛，他可能对美国足球产生前所未有的影响。

subtitles.en: at a level that we haven't seen before for US soccer. So the global thought of this is that Trump pressed his thumb on the scale and said, Gianni, can you please look at this? And they didn't alter
subtitles.zh: 全球的看法是，特朗普施压说“詹尼，请看看这个”，但他们没有改变决定。所以引发了很多问题。
en_highlights: Trump pressed his thumb on the scale

subtitles.en: it. So so many questions emanate from this. First of all, Belgium is appealing. I mean, is there any point in them appealing given that it was probably the president that, you know, talked to in Fantino?
subtitles.zh: 首先，比利时正在上诉。既然可能是总统和因凡蒂诺谈过，他们上诉还有意义吗？

subtitles.en: Can other countries now, you know, say, well, we deserve our red cards overturned? Was this, could this have happened even without President Trump input in the sense that it was a controversial
subtitles.zh: 其他国家现在是否可以说，我们也应该被撤销红牌？如果没有特朗普的介入，这件事会发生吗？毕竟那张红牌本身就有争议。

subtitles.en: red card in the first place? I do not believe that if President Trump had, if he had not made a call, the rule would have, he would flow would not be playing. Now, the question is, is England's,
subtitles.zh: 我认为如果特朗普没有打电话，规则不会改变，普利西奇就不会上场。问题是，英国首相现在会打电话吗？因为他们的一名球员也得了红牌。

subtitles.en: is England Prime Minister going to now make a call? Because one of their players received a red card
subtitles.zh: 英国首相现在会打电话吗？因为他们的一名球员也得了红牌。
